title: Counter borrow operation
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose Boolean forwarding and find modes, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Let $C$ be a base configuration of the loop host on $x$, let $p$ be an input-head position, and let $w$ be a Boolean counter word. Write $j$ for the length of the initial string of false bits in $w$. Then $2j+2\le 2|w|+2$, and after exactly $2j+2$ steps from controller phase $8$, with empty flag and payload tracks and counter track holding $w$ with head at zero, the host has the decremented counter word and head at zero. Its control is the next-anchor call with release true if decrement succeeds, and phase $11$ if it underflows; the input position and all other tracks retain the values prescribed by the frame.
